# Packages and librairies

```{r}
library(here)
library(vroom)
```

# Here configuration

```{r}
here::i_am("DM_Final.Rproj")
```

# Data importation

## EPA Data

```{r}
pollution <- vroom(here("data", "annual_conc_by_monitor_2024.csv"))
```

## ACS Data

```{r}
education <- vroom(here("data", "education.csv"))
employment <- vroom(here("data", "employment.csv"))
ethnicity <- vroom(here("data", "ethnicity.csv"))
median_income <- vroom(here("data", "median_income.csv"))
population <- vroom(here("data", "population.csv"))
```
## Links to the Sources 

Be aware that we purposefully only picked the data series from 2024 even though a longer period was available for the ACS dataset because it's the most recent we have and because the EPA data is only available for 2024.

* EPA DATA : https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/annual_conc_by_monitor_2024.zip

Here's the website https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/download_files.html

* ACS DATA : - population: https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDT1Y2024.B01003?q=B01003&g=010XX00US$0500000
- employment: https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDT1Y2024.B23025?q=B23025&g=010XX00US$0500000
- education: https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDT1Y2024.B15003?q=B15003&g=010XX00US$0500000
- median income: https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDT1Y2024.B19013?q=B19013&g=010XX00US$0500000
- ethnicity: https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDT1Y2024.B03002?q=B03002&g=010XX00US$0500000

The first dataset about pollution per counties in the United States, was published by The Environmental Protection agency and more precisely measured by the Air Quality System (AQS). It's measure system is based on a monitor located in most counties which measures different pollution levels and metrics (ozone, carbone monoxyde ...). Instead of a precise device a monitor represent a place where a parameter is being measure at a given site. 

The second element of our study is a group of datasets representing different measures of socio-economic features in all counties of the US. These measures were collected by the American community survey and more precisely by the Census Bureau and are published every year and  is of the most reliable information source about societey characteristics in America.
